name: WP-IVGS-12 acceptance — double-digit multiplication
description: A short lesson for 8-to-10-year-olds who can already multiply single digits and understand tens and units, but have never multiplied two two-digit numbers. Warm, encouraging, conversational. The learner should finish able to do one themselves, unaided.
learning_outcomes:
LO-1: Given two 2-digit numbers written in column form, the learner will compute their product using the standard column algorithm, producing both partial products with correct carries and a correct final sum.
LO-2: Given the second row of a column multiplication, the learner will explain why a placeholder zero is written in the ones column before multiplying by the tens digit.
LO-3: Given a two-digit multiplication they have just attempted, the learner will check their own work by verifying the column alignment, each partial product, and the placeholder zero.
